# ig-design-system

> Infragistics design system: design tokens generated with igniteui-theming, plus the checks that keep sites consistent. This file is generated by `src/llms.ts` on every build; do not edit it.

One design system for the Infragistics sites. The marketing site and igniteui-astro-components carry a copy of `dist/`; the docs, the API docs and the blog get it through igniteui-astro-components. It ships CSS custom properties and the checks that keep a site on them. It has no components and no JavaScript a page loads.

## Using it in a site

The package is not on npm yet. Until the first release, copy `dist/` from this repository. After it:

```sh
npm install ig-design-system
```

Load the stylesheets in this order, before the site's own styles:

1. `ig-design-system/fonts.css` — optional. The three faces. Leave it out when the site already loads Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans and JetBrains Mono.
2. `ig-design-system/tokens.css` — every token with its default value.
3. `ig-design-system/theme.css` — the live layer: dials, derived state colours, the dark theme, type roles.
4. `ig-design-system/base.css` — optional. Element styles for a site that has none.

A documentation site puts `data-igd-type="docs"` on `<html>` for the smaller type set. `data-theme="dark"` selects the dark theme.

## Rules for code that uses the tokens

- Read a semantic token, `var(--igd-color-text-primary)`. Never read a palette step, `var(--ig-gray-700)`, and never declare one.
- A custom property is `--igd-*` when the design system defines it and `--ig-*` only when the `igniteui-theming` engine emits that exact name.
- Padding uses `--igd-space-inset-*`, vertical margins `--igd-space-stack-*`, gaps and inline margins `--igd-space-gap-*`. Not the raw step `--igd-space-md`.
- A colour has one value per theme. Do not write `light-dark()` pairs of palette steps; the token already switches.
- Hover, active and focus colours are derived from their base token. Override the base on a scope and the states follow.
- Widths, heights and offsets are not tokens. Type them.
- When no token fits, do not invent a value that looks like one. Say which token is missing.
- Check a site with `npx ig-design-system check src`. It reports an unknown token, a raw palette step and a raw spacing step.

## What is in it

- Colour: 131 tokens, plus 101 engine palette steps a site does not read
- Spacing: 45 tokens
- Radius: 7 tokens
- Size: 40 tokens
- Shadow: 41 tokens
- Opacity: 10 tokens
- Font weight: 6 tokens
- Gradient: 8 tokens
- Breakpoint: 4 tokens
- Layer: 8 tokens
- Type: 15 roles (`--igd-type-<role>-font-family`, `-font-size`, `-font-weight`, `-line-height`, `-letter-spacing`, `-text-transform`) and the classes `.igd-type-<role>`
